host.title: List my property

gastronomy.title: List my food business
gastronomy.audience: For restaurants, grills, bakeries, food trucks and any food business that wants to appear in the guide.

experience.title: List my experiences

highlights.item3: One fixed monthly amount: no booking charges you a separate commission.

partner.title: Become a Hospeda partner

highlights.item1: Brand presence in Hospeda's partner carousel.
highlights.item2: Joint visibility in our campaigns and outreach channels.
highlights.item3: Access to the region's network of verified stays and businesses.

hero.title: The whole Litoral, in one place
hero.desc: Find where to sleep, where to eat and what to do along the Río Uruguay coast. Save what you like and talk straight to your host.

1.title: Browse
1.desc: Search stays, restaurants and experiences by destination, type or amenities. No account, no cost.

2.title: Save and compare
2.desc: Bookmark your favourites, sort them into trip collections and put up to five stays side by side.

3.title: Talk to the owner
3.desc: Message them directly on WhatsApp. Hospeda stays out of the way: you agree with your host.

4.title: Tell us how it went
4.desc: Leave a review with photos and help the next traveller decide.

1.a_one: Creating an account is free: you save up to 5 favourites and write reviews. The VIP plan adds unlimited favourites and price alerts, collections, the comparison tool and direct WhatsApp contact, with a {{count}}-day trial.
1.a_other: Creating an account is free: you save up to 5 favourites and write reviews. The VIP plan adds unlimited favourites and price alerts, collections, the comparison tool and direct WhatsApp contact, with a {{count}}-day trial.

2.q: Do you charge a booking fee?
2.a: No. Hospeda does not handle the booking and takes no commission: we put you in touch with the owner and the arrangement is between you.

3.q: Do I need an account to look around?
3.a: No. You can browse the whole site without signing up. An account is only needed to save favourites, get alerts and write reviews.

4.q: Can I cancel whenever I want?
4.a: Yes, from your account and with no paperwork. You keep access until the period you already paid for ends.

billingFaq.title: Questions about payment
billingFaq.trialQ: Can I try it before paying?
billingFaq.trialA_one: Yes. You start with {{count}} free trial day, and the first month is only charged afterwards.
billingFaq.trialA_other: Yes. You start with {{count}} free trial days, and the first month is only charged afterwards.
billingFaq.trialANone: These plans include no trial period: the first month is charged when you subscribe.
billingFaq.cancelQ: Can I cancel whenever I want?
billingFaq.cancelA: Yes, from your account and without calling anyone. You keep the plan until the period you already paid for ends.
billingFaq.changeA: Yes. You can move up or down whenever you like, and the change is settled on the next invoice.
billingFaq.methodA: By card, through MercadoPago. It renews on its own every month until you cancel.
billingFaq.invoiceA: Yes. Every charge generates its receipt and you have it available in your account.
billingFaq.partnerPriceA: Because we do not charge an institution what we charge a corner shop, even at the same level. We share the current figures in the conversation.
